doc: A site on a map (design/map.md, The plan): what stands somewhere, on a flat of its own: a settlement a planner lays out, or one thing a pipeline builds.

fields.name: level
fields.doc: Whether its flat is at `height` (else the land's own there).

fields.name: planner
fields.doc: The planner that lays it out (a planners/ name), if a settlement.

fields.name: pipeline
fields.doc: The pipeline that builds it, if one thing (house, castle...).

fields.name: params
fields.doc: That pipeline's parameters, as a JSON object.

fields.name: yaw
fields.doc: Its turn, degrees (negative: face its first road).
